method: Production simulation and civilian voxel/physics service; no injected damage. Independent geometry fixtures exercise camera/muzzle parallax, containment, near-cover checks, floor/slab normals, and actual effect geometry through delayed chain explosions.

results.test: Pure camera trace does not damage, emit events, spawn VFX, or mutate caller vectors
Exact offset muzzle converges on camera-selected body point and preserves 60-damage, homicide and reset semantics
Camera-clear target is protected by a thin obstacle on the actual muzzle trajectory
Eye-to-muzzle cover guard prevents a barrel clipping through a thin wall from damaging the person beyond it
A muzzle or eye contained in cover stays blocked at zero distance
Ground rays hit the physical floor and raised pavement top with upward normals
Rotated street boxes yield their actual sloped face and a world-space outward normal
Player bullets and bullet-triggered drone, crate and delayed chain deaths create no line or sphere effects
Misses keep the exact muzzle origin and finite unit trajectory without false target hits
